;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**Residents in [[Idlib]], the last [[Syrian opposition]]-held territory, demonstrate against [[President of Syria|President]] [[Bashar Assad]]'s government. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/erdogan-putin-meet-turkey-seeks-solution-idlib-57818556 (ABC News)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[Russian Orthodox Church]] freezes its relations with the [[Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople]] over its influence in [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-religion-russia/russias-orthodox-church-freezes-ties-with-constantinople-over-ukraine-spat-idUSKCN1LU2I8 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]], [[Hurricane Florence]]
**[[Hurricane Florence]] makes landfall in [[Wrightsville Beach, North Carolina]], as a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|Category 1 hurricane]]. and leaves over 895,000 residences and businesses without electrical power. A 105 mph (169 km/h) gust hits [[Wilmington, North Carolina|Wilmington]], the strongest wind recorded there since [[Hurricane Helene (1958)|Hurricane Helene]] in [[1958]]. Florence is later downgraded to a Tropical Storm as it moves inland with sustained winds of {{convert|70|mph|km/h|abbr=on}}. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/hurricane-florence-numbers-latest-power-outages-rain-totals/story?id=57819104 (ABC News)] [http://www.mcall.com/news/os-hurricane-florence-update-0914-story.html (''The Morning Call'')]  [https://apnews.com/b8f08c9c8ae648a19dbf21180809e5fd/4-dead-as-Hurricane-Florence-drenches-the-Carolinas (AP)] [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT1+shtml/142339.shtml (NHC)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-storm-florence-outages-factbox/factbox-more-than-188000-without-power-as-florence-batters-carolinas-idUSKCN1LU0Q4 (Reuters)]
**More than 150 residents in [[New Bern, North Carolina]], are left stranded after {{convert|10|ft|sigfig=1|adj=on}}–high storm surges flood the city. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hurricane-florence-new-bern-north-carolina-150-waiting-to-be-rescued-today-2018-09-14/ (CBS News)]
**At least four people are reported killed in Florence-related incidents. [https://apnews.com/b8f08c9c8ae648a19dbf21180809e5fd/4-dead-as-Hurricane-Florence-drenches-the-Carolinas (AP)]
*[[2018 Pacific typhoon season]], [[Typhoon Mangkhut (2018)|Super Typhoon Mangkhut/Ompong]]
**[[Typhoon Mangkhut (2018)|Super Typhoon Mangkhut (Ompong)]] approaches the Philippines as one of the strongest in its history, with sustained winds of {{convert|205|km/h}} and gusts of up to {{convert|285|km/h|abbr=on}}. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/sep/14/typhoon-mangkhut-thousands-evacuated-as-philippines-braces-for-super-storm (''The Guardian'')]
*The death toll from a [[cholera]] outbreak in [[Zimbabwe]] rises to 25. In response, the government launches a crowdfunding campaign, which has been criticized due to it being started amid allegations of misused state funds. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45520784 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]], [[Inter-Korean Liaison Office]]
**[[North Korea]] and [[South Korea]] open their first [[Inter-Korean Liaison Office|liaison office]] near [[Kaesong]] ahead of the [[September 2018 inter-Korean summit|third summit meeting]] between [[Moon Jae-in]] and [[Kim Jong-un]] in 2018. [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/2164209/korean-diplomacy-intensifies-north-and-south-open-joint-liaison (SCMP)] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2018/09/14/north-and-south-korea-open-first-liaison-office/1300385002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Brexit]]
**[[European Union]] diplomats reject [[Dominic Raab]]'s claim that [[Brexit negotiations|negotiations]] are "closing in". [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2018/sep/14/eu-officials-refute-raab-claim-that-brexit-talks-are-closing-in-on-deal (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Organization of American States]]
**Secretary general [[Luis Almagro]] of the OAS says that he does not exclude "a military intervention to overthrow" [[President of Venezuela]] [[Nicolás Maduro]], arguing that the Maduro government perpetrates "crimes against humanity, the violation of the [[Human rights in Venezuela|human rights]] and the suffering of people that is inducing an [[Bolivarian diaspora|exodus]]". [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/world/article/OAS-chief-threatens-military-force-against-13231653.php (AP via ''Houston Chronicle'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Trials of Paul Manafort]], [[Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**Former [[Donald Trump 2016 presidential campaign|Donald Trump campaign]] chairman [[Paul Manafort]] agrees to plead guilty in a foreign-lobbying and money-laundering case brought by [[Special prosecutor|special counsel]] [[Robert Mueller]]. Manafort has agreed to cooperate with the investigation. [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/09/14/former-trump-campaign-chairman-paul-manafort-appears-to-reach-plea-deal-823882 (''Politico'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45525325 (BBC)]
*[[Corruption in Venezuela]]
** 28 former [[Venezuela|Venezuelan]] officials are charged with corruption by a judge in [[Andorra]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45507588 (BBC)]
